subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】one 一; two 二; three 三; four 四; five 五; six 六; seven 七; eight 八; nine 九; ten 十; brother 兄/弟; plate 盘子
【重点句型】How old are you? 你几岁了？ I'm ... years old. 我……岁。 How many ...? 多少……？ Happy birthday! 生日快乐！ This one, please. 请拿这个。
【A Let's talk】Sam: How old are you? John: I'm six. Sam: Me, too. Happy birthday! John: Thank you. Sam: How many plates? John: Five.
【Read and write】One, two, three, four, five. Count the candles. Six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Happy birthday! I'm six years old. Show me six. Show me seven.
key_points: How old are you? 你几岁了？
This one, please. 请拿这个。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
